description: Get spending grouped by transaction type group (transfer, exchange, deposit, withdrawal, earnings, topup, offramp) for a 7/30/90-day window. Includes period-over-period comparison. For finer breakdowns by user-assigned category, contact, or merchant, use get_spending_by_category / get_spending_by_contact / get_spending_by_merchant. (This tool was previously named get_spending_summary.)

currency.description: Filter by currency (USD, EUR, CHF, CAD, or MXN)
